products.name: Cemetery Cross Ring — sterling silver, US 11
products.nameZh: 克罗心 Cemetery Cross 银戒指（美码 11）
products.introEn: The Cemetery Cross ring turns a repeating motif into a broad silver surface. Raised crosses meet across the band, their bright edges set against dark recesses that make the pattern readable from a distance. It has enough visual presence to anchor the hand on its own, while the repeated shapes reward a closer look. This particular resale example is listed in sterling silver, in US size 11, with a seller-measured width of 20 millimeters. Its scale makes proportion the central consideration: the ring becomes a visible part of the silhouette.
featuresEn: A wide band of repeating raised cross motifs.
Seller lists sterling silver, US size 11 / EU 65 and a 20 mm width.
This exact pre-owned example is graded Excellent, with faint scratches noted.
products.stylingEn: Let the wide band sit beside a plain shirt cuff or a dark knit sleeve, where its outline stays clear. Begin with one statement ring on the hand; a slim bracelet can add another silver note without crowding the fingers.
products.imageAlt: Chrome Hearts Cemetery Cross ring in sterling silver, with raised cross motifs and dark recesses, US size 11.

products.name: CH Forever Ring — .925 silver, US 11
products.nameZh: 克罗心 CH Forever 925 银戒指（美码 11）
products.itemCondition: Good overall; seller describes heavy polishing and signs of consistent wear.
sizes: US ring size 11 (20.6 mm, as listed by seller)
products.introEn: CH Forever gives a simple silver band a distinctly graphic identity. Gothic lettering travels across one face, while small cross motifs bring another rhythm to the surface as the ring turns. The appeal lies in this change of emphasis: a compact shape can read as text, ornament or a quiet strip of metal depending on the angle. This resale example is listed in .925 sterling silver, US size 11. The seller describes substantial polishing and regular wear, details that belong to this individual ring and should inform a closer inspection.
featuresEn: Gothic CH Forever lettering and small cross motifs are visible in the two listing photographs.
Seller lists .925 sterling silver and US size 11 (20.6 mm).
This individual ring is graded Good; heavy polishing and consistent wear are disclosed.
products.stylingEn: Use the band as a small graphic accent with a white T-shirt, dark denim or an open shirt cuff. Leave a little space between neighboring rings so the lettering remains legible, and check the listed size carefully before planning a stack.

products.name: Paper Chain Bracelet — .925 silver, 7 inches
products.nameZh: 克罗心 Paper Chain 925 银手链（7 英寸）
products.itemCondition: Great overall; seller notes general signs of wear.
products.introEn: The Paper Chain bracelet makes its impression through repetition. Closely connected silver links create a continuous line around the wrist, with small engraved details becoming apparent as the bracelet moves. The darker spaces between the links give the surface depth without interrupting that steady rhythm. This exact resale piece is listed in .925 sterling silver and measures seven inches in length according to the seller. Its appeal is easy to understand beside a clean sleeve: the chain brings texture and movement while keeping the overall shape precise and direct.
featuresEn: A continuous chain of linked silver forms with engraved surface details visible in the photographs.
Seller lists .925 sterling silver and a measured length of 7 inches.
This exact resale example is graded Great, with general wear disclosed.
products.stylingEn: Try the bracelet with a short sleeve or a cuff pushed slightly back so the chain can move freely. Pair it with a single silver ring for a measured combination, and compare the stated seven-inch length with a bracelet that already fits comfortably.
